preview.text: Oman and Canada meet for a one-day match at Al Amerat Cricket Ground (Ministry Turf 1), having previously played 7 recorded one-day meetings where Oman won 3 and Canada won 4. Oman won the toss and chose to bat first. The forecast for the next 8 hours predicts up to a 0 per cent chance of rain and about 33 degrees.

summary.text: Oman won by 41 runs. OMAN made 263-10, Hasnain Ul Wahab top-scoring with 93 off 77 balls; Harsh Thaker took 4 for 37. CAN made 215-7, Aaditya Varadarajan top-scoring with 64 off 81 balls; Hassnain Shah took 3 for 29.
